newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian OLOs languish at lower levels with Bunds.
newsitem.headline: Belgian OLOs languish at lower levels with Bunds.

text.p: Belgian bonds wallowed at lower levels late on Wednesday afternoon, watching U.S. Treasuries seesaw following weaker-than-expected durable goods data and with domestic political concerns hanging overhead.
By 1545 GMT the benchmark March 2007 OLO was yielding 5.85 percent compared to 5.82 at the previous close, its yield premium over equivalent German paper steady at six basis points.

"The bull trend seems to have been a bit broken," one dealer said. He added that a scandal of alleged corruption surrounding the francophone PS socialist party which has errupted in the past dew days was still weighing somewhat on sentiment.

However, he and others said they did not think the scandal posed much of a threat to Belgium's four-party coalition which is made up of French and Dutch speaking socialist and Christian democrat parties.
"I think the PS will sacrifice a few heads, but the government will not fall over this," the dealer added.

OLOs and the Belgian franc suffered jitters on Tuesday on news police raided PS headquarters, apparently in connection with a bribes inquiry dating back to 1989. Two senior party officials were arrested last week and were charged with corruption on Monday.
